items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.implication: BUF WR depth shifts; Palmer active as beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Increased role for Josh Palmer and other BUF WRs.

items.text: Actives today include: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Judkins, Tyler Warren.
items.why: Official actives confirmation for previously uncertain players.
items.implication: Clears starts for Olave/Kamara/Caleb; Dowdle active but Warren (PIT) thriving.
items.opportunity: Safe volume for cleared players; Dowdle flex but secondary to Jaylen Warren.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings PS Tuesday).
items.why: Confirmed inactive; thin depth chart noted with sizes/history.
items.implication: Low-upside committee for CLE RBs; McLaughlin preferred for pass work.
items.opportunity: Flex consideration for McLaughlin on volume vs BAL.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active. Still no word on DJ Moore at time of post.
items.why: Direct status update from ETR injury summary quote.
items.implication: Projections updated; Spears gets active role boost potential.
items.opportunity: TEN RB usage; IND TE streamers.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell both officially active; previously likely to play with AJ Brown returning.
items.why: Sources earlier said likely; confirmed active. NE close to full health with AJB back.
items.implication: Henderson startable; AJ Brown full role return.
items.opportunity: NE offense healthy; Henderson carries/targets available.

items.text: Whoa on Tyler Warren inactive (surprising despite IR). Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among fave streamer TEs.
items.why: Warren out creates TE streaming need.

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today (with Warren out on IND side).
items.implication: TEN RB committee includes Spears; relevant with IND TE Warren out.

items.text: If starting NYG RB still Cam Skattebo for explosiveness/best TD chance vs NO, but riskier now (flex not RB2) after rotation change reports favoring Najee larger role. Updated: Skattebo RB28, Najee RB33.
items.why: Fumbles led to downgrade in rotation; still likes explosiveness vs Saints run defense.
items.implication: Prefer Skattebo over Najee/DK in some spots but elevated risk.
items.conflict: Levitan highlights poor YOE/fumbles as caution.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Amid reports of Giants RB rotation change favoring larger Najee role.
items.why: Poor efficiency (YOE) + fumbles; sources say Najee larger role, Skattebo downgraded but still in mix; all 4 RBs active.
items.implication: Riskier start; more of a flex than RB2.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris role expansion vs NO; Skattebo still explosive upside but committee risk.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers starting Skattebo over Najee for explosiveness/TD chance.

items.text: Weekend FF reports summary: GTD Judkins, Tyler Warren, Mike Evans/Christian Kirk. Expected: Caleb Williams, Olave/Kamara, AJ Brown/Henderson, DK Metcalf, Freiermuth, Sadiq. Not expected: Deebo, Croskey-Merritt, Sean Tucker. Activated: Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for key statuses pre-inactives.
items.implication: Core tracking for last-minute; many expected cleared to active later.
items.opportunity: Monitor GTD for beneficiaries; expected players safe starts.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) and WR Chris Olave (illness) both Q and both expected to play (later confirmed active).
items.why: Sources confirm expected; official active later.
items.opportunity: Full roles in NO offense vs NYG.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense nightmare for WRs/TEs.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass catchers; Evans usage in good spot.
items.opportunity: High target/TD potential vs weak secondary.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage.
items.why: Reliable usage you can bank on.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
items.why: Elite usage lately; ARI run defense leaks.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Ugly matchup vs Seattle; shaky QB situation.

items.text: Hates J.K. Dobbins vs SEA (RB27) facing run defense that shuts backs down.
